## Pull request overview

This PR introduces a structured plugin system with dependency-aware loading/unloading, a typed lazy plugin loader for React-based plugins, and a CLI to scaffold new plugin packages, together with documentation describing the plugin architecture and workflow.

**Changes:**
- Added a `PluginSystem` in `@object-ui/core` with dependency validation, lifecycle hooks (`onLoad`/`onUnload`), and tests, and exported it from the core entrypoint.
- Introduced a `createLazyPlugin` helper in `@object-ui/react` with tests for lazy loading, fallback rendering, prop passing, and error handling.
- Added a new `@object-ui/create-plugin` CLI package (with build config, package metadata, and README) plus a top-level `PLUGIN_SYSTEM.md` documenting plugin registration, lazy loading, and the scaffolding workflow.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 13 out of 14 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `pnpm-lock.yaml` | Locks new runtime and dev dependencies for the `@object-ui/create-plugin` package and its type packages. |
| `packages/react/src/index.ts` | Re-exports `createLazyPlugin` from `LazyPluginLoader` as part of the public `@object-ui/react` API. |
| `packages/react/src/LazyPluginLoader.tsx` | Implements `createLazyPlugin` with a `LazyPluginOptions` interface and a Suspense-wrapped lazy component factory, supporting typed props and optional fallback UI. |
| `packages/react/src/__tests__/LazyPluginLoader.test.tsx` | Adds tests verifying lazy resolution, custom fallback rendering, prop propagation, and error handling behavior for `createLazyPlugin`. |
| `packages/create-plugin/tsup.config.ts` | Configures tsup to build the `@object-ui/create-plugin` CLI as an ESM bundle with type declarations. |
| `packages/create-plugin/tsconfig.json` | Sets up TypeScript compilation for the CLI package, targeting `src` and outputting to `dist`. |
| `packages/create-plugin/src/index.ts` | Implements the interactive/non-interactive CLI for scaffolding plugin packages, including secure plugin name validation, generation of `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `vite.config.ts`, README, component implementation, types, and test templates. |
| `packages/create-plugin/package.json` | Declares the new `@object-ui/create-plugin` package, its CLI binary entry, scripts, and dependencies (chalk, commander, fs-extra, prompts, etc.). |
| `packages/create-plugin/README.md` | Documents how to invoke the `@object-ui/create-plugin` CLI via `npm/pnpm create` and `npx`, and describes the generated plugin structure and workflow. |
| `packages/core/src/registry/PluginSystem.ts` | Adds the `PluginDefinition` interface and `PluginSystem` class with dependency checks, lifecycle hooks, load/unload logic, and query helpers (`isLoaded`, `getPlugin`, `getLoadedPlugins`, `getAllPlugins`). |
| `packages/core/src/registry/__tests__/PluginSystem.test.ts` | Provides unit tests covering basic loading, async lifecycle hooks, dependency enforcement, unload constraints, error cases, and registry integration for `PluginSystem`. |
| `packages/core/src/index.ts` | Makes `PluginSystem` (and `PluginDefinition`) available to consumers via the core package’s public API surface. |
| `package.json` | Adds a root `create-plugin` script to run the built CLI from `packages/create-plugin`. |
| `PLUGIN_SYSTEM.md` | Introduces comprehensive documentation on plugin definitions, lifecycle and dependency management, lazy loading via `createLazyPlugin`, the scaffolding CLI usage, and integration patterns across ObjectUI. |
</details>

## Unused variable, import, function or class

Unused variable templateDir.

[Show more details](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/security/code-scanning/164)

The Vite config template for generated plugins only marks React-related packages as externals, which diverges from existing plugin configs that also treat internal ObjectUI packages and `lucide-react` as externals. This will cause generated plugins to bundle `@object-ui/*` and icon dependencies instead of relying on the host app’s copies, increasing bundle size and duplicating code. To align with the rest of the codebase (e.g. `packages/plugin-grid/vite.config.ts:21-29`), consider extending the `rollupOptions.external` array here to include the same set of `@object-ui/*` and icon packages.
